name: M4-Y10
description: M4-Y10 was a small astromech droid present on the planet Tatooine in 3626 BBY. The droid had black plating and antenna along with a red photoreceptor and stripes across its three legs and on the left side of its body. The right side had a white stripe. M4-Y10 had a cylindrical body and a wider round head.
